prosody_instruction: Speak softly, as if thinking aloud to oneself rather than addressing anyone. Slow pace, drifting cadence, occasional trailing-off at clause ends. Avoid directive intonation. The tone should feel introspective, distracted, almost wandering — like someone remembering, imagining, or recounting to themselves rather than asking a listener for help.

chunks.text: I was cleaning out old screenshots from my 2025 trips and found that train info I saved for the Beijing to Shanghai run—wild how fast that week went.
And then right after that I detoured to Xi'an—my notes literally just say “Xi’an attractions” like I was going to be organized for once.
Oh, and I remember obsessively refreshing that one delivery page back then—tracking number SF1234567890—because the package was supposedly “out for delivery” forever.
For the Beijing–Shanghai leg, my coworker Ethan Thomas ended up on train G3 in First Class, so I just copied his setup instead of thinking about it.
I’m pretty sure that G3 ride was on 2025-05-15—at least that’s what my calendar from back then shows.
In Xi’an we did the Bell Tower on 2025-03-19, afternoon slot, and it was booked under Zhao Min—2 tickets—still have the confirmation screenshot somewhere.
